title: Action-Value Calibration via Continuation Sharing for Long-Horizon Agentic Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 基于延续共享的长期智能体强化学习动作值校准

paragraphs.en: Reinforcement learning for long-horizon agents relies on feedback from sequences of interactions, making credit assignment to individual actions difficult. Existing methods such as GiGPO compare actions at shared states to compute relative advantages, but estimate each action’s value from a single sampled continuation. The resulting local credit remains sensitive to decisions made later in the trajectory. To address this problem, we propose ConCal ( Con tinuation Cal ibration), a recursive continuation-value estimator that incorporates continuation evidence already present in a rollout batch. ConCal matches visits from the same task by their incoming state-action-state transitions, combines shared continuation evidence with each visit’s own transition estimate, and propagates calibrated values backward to refine earlier action-value estimates. This reduces dependence on individual sampled continuations and mitigates local credit distortions without additional rollouts. Held-out return diagnostics show lower error in within-group value differences and higher agreement with reference action orderings than estimates based on individual continuations. With Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, ConCal improves success rates over GiGPO by 3.39 and 5.86 percentage points on ALFWorld and WebShop, respectively. Our code is available at https://github.com/Yingjian-Chen/ConCal .
paragraphs.zh: 长时程智能体的强化学习依赖于交互序列的反馈，这使得对单个动作进行信用分配十分困难。 现有方法（如 GiGPO）通过在共享状态下比较动作来计算相对优势，但每个动作的价值仅从单次采样的后续轨迹中估计。 由此得到的局部信用仍然对轨迹中后续做出的决策敏感。 为解决这一问题，我们提出 ConCal（Continuation Calibration，后续校准），这是一种递归的后续价值估计器，能够利用 rollout 批次中已有的后续证据。 ConCal 通过入边的状态-动作-状态转移匹配同一任务中的访问，将共享的后续证据与每次访问自身的转移估计相结合，并将校准后的价值向后传播，以改进先前的动作价值估计。 这降低了对单次采样后续轨迹的依赖，并在不增加额外 rollout 的情况下缓解了局部信用失真。 留出回报诊断显示，与基于单次后续轨迹的估计相比，我们的方法在组内价值差异上的误差更低，与参考动作排序的一致性更高。 使用 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct，ConCal 在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上的成功率分别比 GiGPO 提高了 3.39 和 5.86 个百分点。 我们的代码已发布于 https://github.com/Yingjian-Chen/ConCal 。

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) ( Achiam et al., 2023 ; Qwen et al., 2025 ) support agents that reason, invoke tools, and interact with external environments ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Schick et al., 2023 ) . In web navigation and embodied tasks ( He et al., 2024 ; Ichter et al., 2023 ) , agents execute sequences of actions and adapt their decisions to changing observations ( Xi et al., 2025 ) . Reinforcement learning (RL) trains these behaviors from task outcomes ( Wei et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Jin et al., 2025 ) . A central challenge is to translate feedback on the full interaction into credit for individual decisions.

paragraphs.en: Group-based RL estimates relative advantages from trajectories sampled for the same task. In trajectory-level GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) , every action in a trajectory receives the same episode-relative advantage, as illustrated in Figure 1 (a). GiGPO ( Feng et al., 2025 ) introduces local comparisons by grouping actions at shared state anchors and comparing their discounted returns, as illustrated in Figure 1 (b). The comparison is local, but the value estimate for each action still comes from its own sampled continuation. Consequently, a low return does not distinguish a poor decision from a useful decision followed by later failure. Similarly, a high return does not identify which earlier decisions contributed to success. The credit conflicts in Figure 2 illustrate the variability of these estimates on subsets of WebShop ( Yao et al., 2022 ) and ALFWorld ( Shridhar et al., 2021 ) rollouts. State grouping determines which actions are compared, while continuation estimation determines the values entering that comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 基于分组的强化学习从为同一任务采样的轨迹中估计相对优势。 在轨迹级 GRPO（Shao et al., 2024）中，轨迹中的每个动作都获得相同的相对整个回合的优势，如图 1（a）所示。 GiGPO（Feng et al., 2025）通过在共享状态锚点处对动作分组并比较其折扣回报来引入局部比较，如图 1（b）所示。 这种比较是局部的，但每个动作的价值估计仍然来自其自身采样的后续延续。 因此，低回报无法区分一个糟糕的决策和一个有用但随后遭遇失败的决策。 同样，高回报也无法识别哪些较早的决策对成功做出了贡献。 图 2 中的信用冲突展示了这些估计在 WebShop（Yao et al., 2022）和 ALFWorld（Shridhar et al., 2021）部分 rollout 上的可变性。 状态分组决定了哪些动作被比较，而延续估计决定了进入该比较的数值。

paragraphs.en: The rollout batch also contains evidence beyond each individual continuation. Existing approaches reuse cross-trajectory structure through transition-level advantage averaging and graph-based credit estimation ( Li et al., 2026 ; Cheng et al., 2026 ; Yao et al., 2026 ) . For a given task, repeated transitions with the same starting state, executed action, and resulting state link that action to several observed continuations, as illustrated in Figure 1 (c). The visits following these transitions provide shared evidence about subsequent returns, while each visit records a particular reward and successor within its own trajectory. A single pooled value removes these differences from the estimates assigned to matched visits. Our insight is to calibrate action values by combining shared continuation evidence with each visit’s own transition estimate and propagating the resulting estimates backward to earlier decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体展开批次还包含超出每个单独续写片段的证据。 现有方法通过转移层面的优势平均和基于图的信用估计来复用跨轨迹结构（Li et al., 2026；Cheng et al., 2026；Yao et al., 2026）。 对于给定任务，具有相同起始状态、执行动作和结果状态的重复转移将该动作与多个观察到的续写片段联系起来，如图 1（c）所示。 这些转移之后的访问为后续回报提供了共享证据，而每次访问在其自身轨迹中记录了特定的奖励和后继状态。 单一合并值会把这些差异从分配给匹配访问的估计中消除。 我们的洞察是，通过将共享的续写证据与每次访问自身的转移估计相结合来校准动作值，并将所得估计向较早的决策反向传播。

paragraphs.en: Accordingly, we propose Con tinuation Cal ibration ( ConCal ), a recursive estimator of continuation values. ConCal matches visits by their incoming state-action-state transitions and blends the transition estimate of each visit with the mean estimate of matched visits. This partial sharing retains a separate estimate for each visit. Recursive updates carry the calibrated continuation values backward along recorded trajectories, allowing earlier action-value estimates to incorporate evidence from other rollouts. Each action is evaluated from its own observed reward and the calibrated continuation value of its actual successor, without collecting additional rollouts. The illustrative held-out diagnostics in Figure 2 show lower error in relative values and greater local credit consistency than estimates based on individual continuations.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们提出延续校准（ConCal），一种延续值的递归估计器。 ConCal 通过进入的“状态-动作-状态”转移来匹配访问，并将每次访问的转移估计与匹配访问的均值估计相融合。 这种部分共享为每次访问保留了独立的估计。 递归更新将校准后的延续值沿记录的轨迹向后传递，使较早的动作值估计能够纳入来自其他 rollout 的证据。 每个动作都根据其自身观测到的奖励和其实际后继的校准延续值来评估，无需收集额外的 rollout。 图 2 中的示例性留出诊断显示，相较于基于单个延续的估计，该方法在相对值上的误差更低，且局部信用一致性更高。

paragraphs.en: In summary, our contributions are as follows: (1) Analysis of Local Credit Assignment. We analyze the dependence of return-based local credit on individual sampled continuations through credit-conflict measurements and held-out relative-value diagnostics. (2) Calibrating Local Action Values. We introduce ConCal, which combines shared continuation evidence from matched visits with each visit’s own transition estimate through recursive updates to refine local action-value estimates within the existing rollout batch. (3) Empirical Evaluation. With Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, ConCal improves success rates over GiGPO by 3.39 and 5.86 percentage points on ALFWorld and WebShop, respectively, and achieves higher reported mean success rates than GraphGPO on both benchmarks. Ablations support recursive sharing and retention of individual transition estimates, while diagnostics examine relative-value magnitudes and action orderings.
paragraphs.zh: 总而言之，我们的贡献如下：（1）局部信用分配分析。 我们通过信用冲突测量和留出相对价值诊断，分析了基于回报的局部信用对单个采样延续的依赖性。 （2）校准局部动作价值。 我们提出 ConCal，它通过递归更新，将来自匹配访问的共享延续证据与每次访问自身的转移估计相结合，以在现有 rollout 批次内精炼局部动作价值估计。 （3）实证评估。 使用 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct，ConCal 在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上分别将成功率比 GiGPO 提升了 3.39 和 5.86 个百分点，并且在两个基准上都取得了高于 GraphGPO 所报告的平均成功率。 消融实验支持递归共享以及保留单个转移估计，同时诊断检查了相对价值幅度和动作排序。

paragraphs.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has been applied to align language models with human preferences ( Ouyang et al., 2022 ) and train agents through interaction with external environments ( Carta et al., 2023 ) . Multi-turn RL enables agents to learn sequential decision-making from environment feedback ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) , with applications spanning device control ( Bai et al., 2024 ) , web navigation ( Wei et al., 2025 ) , and search-augmented reasoning ( Jin et al., 2025 ) . Recent frameworks further support long-horizon training across diverse interactive environments ( Xi et al., 2026 ) . Our work focuses on credit assignment in long-horizon agentic RL.
paragraphs.zh: 强化学习（RL）已被应用于使语言模型与人类偏好对齐（Ouyang et al., 2022），以及通过智能体与外部环境的交互来训练智能体（Carta et al., 2023）。 多轮强化学习使智能体能够从环境反馈中学习序贯决策（Zhou et al., 2024），其应用涵盖设备控制（Bai et al., 2024）、网页导航（Wei et al., 2025）以及检索增强推理（Jin et al., 2025）。 最近的框架进一步支持在多样化的交互环境中进行长时程训练（Xi et al., 2026）。 我们的工作聚焦于长时程智能体强化学习中的信用分配问题。

sents.en: Multi-turn RL enables agents to learn sequential decision-making from environment feedback ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) , with applications spanning device control ( Bai et al., 2024 ) , web navigation ( Wei et al., 2025 ) , and search-augmented reasoning ( Jin et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 多轮强化学习使智能体能够从环境反馈中学习序贯决策（Zhou et al., 2024），其应用涵盖设备控制（Bai et al., 2024）、网页导航（Wei et al., 2025）以及检索增强推理（Jin et al., 2025）。

sents.en: Recent frameworks further support long-horizon training across diverse interactive environments ( Xi et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 最近的框架进一步支持在多样化的交互环境中进行长时程训练（Xi et al., 2026）。

sents.en: Our work focuses on credit assignment in long-horizon agentic RL.
sents.zh: 我们的工作聚焦于长时程智能体强化学习中的信用分配问题。

paragraphs.en: Group-based RL estimates relative advantages from sampled rewards without a learned value baseline ( Ahmadian et al., 2024 ; Shao et al., 2024 ) . Subsequent work improves optimization and sampling to address training bias and instability ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2025 ) . For multi-turn agents, local comparisons extend from shared state anchors to groups that account for historical context ( Feng et al., 2025 ; He et al., 2026 ) . Our work focuses on calibrating the action-value estimates entering these local comparisons through shared continuation evidence from matched visits.
paragraphs.zh: 基于分组的强化学习从采样奖励中估计相对优势，而无需学习价值基线（Ahmadian et al., 2024；Shao et al., 2024）。 后续工作改进了优化与采样，以解决训练偏差和不稳定性（Liu et al., 2025；Yu et al., 2025）。 对于多轮智能体，局部比较从共享状态锚点扩展到考虑历史上下文的分组（Feng et al., 2025；He et al., 2026）。 我们的工作专注于通过来自匹配访问的共享续接证据，校准进入这些局部比较的动作价值估计。

paragraphs.en: Shared structure across trajectories provides additional evidence for step-level credit assignment. Tree-GRPO adopts tree-search sampling and computes relative advantages within and across trees ( Ji et al., 2026 ) . SALT averages trajectory-level advantages over matched state-action-state transitions ( Li et al., 2026 ) . GraphGPO aggregates rollouts into a state-transition graph and derives step-level credit from shortest-path distances to successful terminal states ( Cheng et al., 2026 ) . GRAFT estimates state values through Bellman updates on a trajectory graph and derives step-level credit from these values ( Yao et al., 2026 ) . PGPO augments step-level advantages by incorporating differences between state potentials estimated from grouped returns ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) . In this paper, we introduce ConCal to calibrate local action values by recursively combining shared continuation evidence with visit-specific transition estimates, with an in-depth analysis revealing how calibration and normalization shape action preferences and local credit.
paragraphs.zh: 轨迹间的共享结构为步级信用分配提供了额外证据。 Tree-GRPO 采用树搜索采样，并在树内与树间计算相对优势（Ji et al., 2026）。 SALT 对匹配的状态-动作-状态转移上的轨迹级优势取平均（Li et al., 2026）。 GraphGPO 将 rollout 聚合为状态转移图，并根据到成功终止状态的最短路径距离推导步级信用（Cheng et al., 2026）。 GRAFT 通过在轨迹图上进行 Bellman 更新来估计状态价值，并基于这些价值推导步级信用（Yao et al., 2026）。 PGPO 通过引入由分组回报估计的状态势函数之间的差异来增强步级优势（Zheng et al., 2026）。 在本文中，我们提出 ConCal，通过递归地结合共享的后续证据与特定访问的转移估计来校准局部动作价值，并通过深入分析揭示校准与归一化如何塑造动作偏好和局部信用。

paragraphs.en: We introduce ConCal , a recursive continuation-value estimator that evaluates actions from continuation evidence shared across existing rollouts. Figure 3 illustrates three steps. Matching Visits identifies visits that share continuation evidence. Recursive Continuation Calibration blends individual transition estimates with the matched mean. Action Values and Policy Optimization converts calibrated continuation values into action values and relative advantages for policy updates.

ALFWorld comprises six categories of household tasks performed through text-based interactions. WebShop requires agents to search for and purchase products that satisfy user requirements. We report overall and per-category success rates on ALFWorld, and average task score and success rate on WebShop.

paragraphs.en: Table 1 compares ConCal with existing methods on ALFWorld and WebShop. ConCal achieves the highest reported aggregate mean success rates among the compared methods, reaching 94.27% overall success on ALFWorld and a task score of 90.18 with 79.69% success on WebShop. paragraphs.en: To investigate how shared evidence calibrates relative action values, we compare Own-MC and ConCal on the same frozen rollouts for each benchmark, with held-out continuation returns as the reference, following the split described in Appendix D . Own-MC estimates each action value from the Monte Carlo return along the same trajectory, as in GiGPO. We measure group-centered value MSE and action-order agreement to assess the accuracy of value differences and preference direction. Gap-matched serves as a diagnostic control that rescales the centered Own-MC values in each group to the norm of the ConCal estimates while preserving their ordering. This tests how much of the estimation-error reduction can be reproduced by adjusting preference strength alone. Figure 5 shows that ConCal reduces centered-value MSE by 34.3% on ALFWorld and 16.8% on WebShop. Gap-matched reproduces most of the MSE reduction while preserving the Own-MC ordering, showing that much of the error reduction can be recovered by adjusting preference strength alone. ConCal also increases ordering agreement from 58.8% to 61.2% and from 74.5% to 81.8%, respectively. Within the evaluated comparison groups, these results show that shared continuations improve relative action-value estimates by calibrating preference strength and increasing agreement with the reference ordering.
paragraphs.zh: 为了研究共享证据如何校准相对动作价值，我们按照附录 D 中描述的划分，在每个基准上对相同的冻结 rollout 比较 Own-MC 与 ConCal，以留出的后续回报作为参考。 Own-MC 按照 GiGPO 的方式，沿同一条轨迹用蒙特卡洛回报估计每个动作价值。 我们测量以组为中心的价值 MSE 和动作顺序一致性，以评估价值差异的准确性和偏好方向的准确性。 Gap-matched 是一种诊断性对照，它在保持排序不变的情况下，将每组中以组为中心的 Own-MC 价值重新缩放到 ConCal 估计值的范数。 这测试了仅通过调整偏好强度能够复现多少估计误差的降低。 图 5 显示，ConCal 在 ALFWorld 上将以组为中心的价值 MSE 降低了 34.3%，在 WebShop 上降低了 16.8%。 Gap-matched 在保持 Own-MC 排序的同时复现了大部分 MSE 的降低，表明大部分误差降低可以通过仅调整偏好强度来恢复。 ConCal 还分别将顺序一致性从 58.8% 提高到 61.2%，以及从 74.5% 提高到 81.8%。 在所评估的比较组内，这些结果表明共享的后续片段通过校准偏好强度并提高与参考排序的一致性，改进了相对动作价值估计。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate continuation estimation through task-performance ablations and normalization through frozen-estimate diagnostics.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过任务性能消融实验来评估延续估计，并通过冻结估计诊断来评估归一化。

paragraphs.en: We further compare ConCal with Own-MC and two variants to examine how continuation estimation contributes to task performance. Single-pass shares continuation returns once, without recursively propagating updated estimates backward. Fully pooled retains recursion but assigns each matched visit the pooled mean, removing its separate visit-specific contribution. All other components and settings remain unchanged. Table 2 supports three findings. (1) All three estimators that share continuation evidence (Single-pass, Fully pooled, and ConCal) outperform Own-MC across the reported metrics, supporting the benefit of using evidence from other trajectories. (2) ConCal achieves higher success rates than Single-pass on both benchmarks, supporting the recursive incorporation of updated estimates into earlier decisions. Their WebShop task scores are close, with a slightly higher mean for Single-pass and less variation across seeds for ConCal. (3) ConCal outperforms Fully pooled across all metrics, indicating that retaining each visit’s own estimate remains useful even when continuations are shared. Together, these findings support ConCal’s design of recursive evidence reuse with visit-specific estimation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进一步将 ConCal 与 Own-MC 及两个变体进行比较，以考察延续估计对任务表现的贡献。 Single-pass 只共享一次延续回报，而不递归地将更新后的估计向回传播。 Fully pooled 保留递归，但为每个匹配的访问分配合并均值，移除其单独的访问特定贡献。 所有其他组件和设置保持不变。 表 2 支持三项发现。 (1) 三种共享延续证据的估计器（Single-pass、Fully pooled 和 ConCal）在所报告的指标上均优于 Own-MC，这支持了利用其他轨迹证据的益处。 (2) ConCal 在两个基准上的成功率均高于 Single-pass，这支持了将更新后的估计递归融入较早决策的做法。 它们在 WebShop 任务分数上接近，Single-pass 的均值略高，而 ConCal 在不同随机种子间的波动更小。 (3) ConCal 在所有指标上都优于 Fully pooled，这表明即使在延续被共享的情况下，保留每次访问自身的估计仍然有用。 总之，这些发现支持了 ConCal 采用递归证据复用与访问特定估计的设计。

paragraphs.en: To examine whether normalization preserves the preference strength calibrated by ConCal, we test whether groups with larger value gaps receive stronger step advantages. For this diagnostic comparison, we apply group-wise and batch-wise normalization to the same frozen ConCal estimates and compare step-advantage magnitudes across five bins ordered from smaller to larger value gaps. Figure 6 shows that group-wise normalization produces similar median advantage magnitudes across bins on both benchmarks. Groups with small calibrated value gaps therefore receive step signals comparable in magnitude to those with large gaps, weakening the distinction between weak and strong estimated action preferences. Under batch-wise normalization, median advantage magnitudes increase with value spread, so smaller gaps receive weaker step signals and larger gaps receive stronger signals. This preserves the preference-strength differences calibrated by ConCal and supports our adoption of batch-wise normalization when computing step advantages.
paragraphs.zh: 为检验归一化是否保留了由 ConCal 校准出的偏好强度，我们测试价值差距较大的组是否获得更强的步级优势。 在这一诊断性比较中，我们对同一组冻结的 ConCal 估计值分别应用组级归一化和批级归一化，并比较按价值差距从小到大排序的五个分箱之间的步级优势幅度。 图 6 显示，组级归一化在两个基准上的各分箱间产生了相似的中位优势幅度。 因此，校准后价值差距较小的组获得的步级信号在幅度上与差距较大的组相当，削弱了弱估计动作偏好与强估计动作偏好之间的区分度。 在批级归一化下，中位优势幅度随价值离散度增加而增大，因此较小的差距获得较弱的步级信号，较大的差距获得较强的信号。 这保留了由 ConCal 校准出的偏好强度差异，也支持我们在计算步级优势时采用批级归一化。

sents.en: Groups with small calibrated value gaps therefore receive step signals comparable in magnitude to those with large gaps, weakening the distinction between weak and strong estimated action preferences.

sents.en: Under batch-wise normalization, median advantage magnitudes increase with value spread, so smaller gaps receive weaker step signals and larger gaps receive stronger signals.

sents.zh: 这保留了由 ConCal 校准出的偏好强度差异，也支持我们在计算步级优势时采用批级归一化。

paragraphs.en: To assess the computational cost and coverage of ConCal, we examine stage runtimes and the fraction of actions covered by shared continuation evidence. Figure 7 (a) shows that rollout is the most time-consuming training stage, taking 108.85 s on average, followed by policy updates at 19.00 s. In separate frozen-batch replays, visit matching and recursive calibration for ConCal take 0.0375 s and 0.0019 s per batch, respectively, under the measurement setup in Appendix D . Figure 7 (b) shows that directly matched next visits provide shared continuation evidence for 55.4% of recorded actions on ALFWorld and 43.4% on WebShop. Recursive propagation extends this coverage to 92.5% and 67.5%, respectively, allowing earlier actions to access shared continuation evidence even when their immediate successor visits have no cross-trajectory matches. paragraphs.en: We present a WebShop case study of local credit assignment for web agents (Figure 8 ). The task requires Zest color and size 5X, but the agent has selected only the color. GiGPO estimates each action’s value from its own sampled continuation. It assigns negative step advantage to Select 5X because its continuation ends in task failure, while favoring Repeat Zest , whose trajectory succeeds, yielding a value gap of Δ ​ G = − 6.9834 \Delta G=-6.9834 . ConCal calibrates action-value estimates using evidence from multiple continuations and reverses this preference, with Δ ​ Q ~ = + 0.6452 \Delta\widetilde{Q}=+0.6452 . It assigns positive step advantage to Select 5X despite its failed sampled continuation, favoring completion of the required size selection. This case illustrates how ConCal uses shared continuation evidence to assign positive local credit to useful actions despite failures in their own sampled continuations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们以 WebShop 为案例，研究网络智能体的局部信用分配（图 8）。 该任务要求 Zest 颜色且尺码为 5X，但智能体只选择了颜色。 GiGPO 从每个动作自身采样的后续轨迹来估计其价值。 它给 Select 5X 分配负的步级优势，因为其后续轨迹以任务失败告终，而更偏好 Repeat Zest，其轨迹成功，产生 Δ G = − 6.9834 的价值差距。 ConCal 利用来自多个后续轨迹的证据来校准动作价值估计，并逆转了这一偏好，得到 Δ Q ~ = + 0.6452。 尽管其采样的后续轨迹失败了，ConCal 仍给 Select 5X 分配正的步级优势，偏向完成必要的尺码选择。 该案例说明 ConCal 如何利用共享的后续轨迹证据，在自身采样后续轨迹失败的情况下，仍为有用动作分配正的局部信用。

paragraphs.en: We introduce ConCal, a recursive continuation-value estimator for long-horizon agentic reinforcement learning. ConCal combines evidence from matched visits with the transition estimate of each visit and propagates calibrated continuation values to earlier decisions without additional rollouts. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop show improved task performance, with ablations supporting both recursive evidence reuse and visit-specific estimation. Further analyses show that shared continuations calibrate preference strength and improve agreement with action orderings derived from held-out returns. These findings support calibrating relative action-value estimates with shared continuation evidence from existing rollout groups in the evaluated settings.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 ConCal，一种用于长程智能体强化学习的递归延续值估计器。 ConCal 将匹配访问的证据与每次访问的转移估计相结合，并在无需额外采样的情况下，将校准后的延续值传播到更早的决策。 在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上的实验表明任务性能得到提升，消融实验同时支持递归证据复用与访问特定的估计。 进一步分析表明，共享的延续值可以校准偏好强度，并提升与由留出回报导出的动作排序之间的一致性。 这些发现支持在所评估的设置中，利用现有采样组中的共享延续证据来校准相对动作值估计。

paragraphs.en: The matching rule of ConCal relies on observed incoming transitions and does not enforce agreement in the full interaction history, hidden state, or remaining interaction budget. Such differences can introduce bias into the shared estimates incorporated into subsequent recursive updates. The extent of continuation reuse also depends on the availability of matching visits within the rollout batch. Future work could refine matching with relevant historical information while maintaining sharing coverage, and account for uncertainty in continuation estimates.
paragraphs.zh: ConCal 的匹配规则依赖于观测到的到达转移，不要求在完整交互历史、隐藏状态或剩余交互预算上保持一致。 这些差异可能会给共享估计引入偏差，而这些共享估计会被纳入后续的递归更新中。 延续复用的程度还取决于回放批次中匹配访问的可用性。 未来的工作可以在保持共享覆盖率的同时，利用相关历史信息改进匹配，并考虑延续估计中的不确定性。

paragraphs.en: WebShop ( Yao et al., 2022 ) is a simulated shopping environment in which agents purchase products that satisfy natural-language requests. Following the WebShop setting of GraphGPO ( Cheng et al., 2026 ) , we adopt the text-rich interface, which presents page content and identifies interactive elements. We conduct experiments in the 1,000-product environment with programmatically generated goals. Goals with indices 0–499 form the evaluation pool, and the remaining goals form the training pool. Each episode allows up to 15 environment interactions. The environment assigns the purchased product a match score in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] based on its type, attributes, selected options, and price relative to the request. We report task score as the mean match score multiplied by 100 and success rate as the percentage of episodes with a match score of 1. Task score captures partial satisfaction of the requirements, whereas success rate measures complete task fulfillment.
paragraphs.zh: WebShop（Yao 等，2022）是一个模拟购物环境，智能体在其中购买满足自然语言请求的商品。 遵循 GraphGPO（Cheng 等，2026）的 WebShop 设置，我们采用文本丰富的界面，该界面呈现页面内容并标识可交互元素。 我们在包含 1,000 个商品的环境中进行实验，目标是程序化生成的。 索引为 0–499 的目标构成评估池，其余目标构成训练池。 每个回合最多允许 15 次环境交互。 环境会根据所购商品相对于请求的类型、属性、所选选项和价格，为其分配一个 [0,1] 区间内的匹配分数。 我们报告的任务分数为匹配分数的均值乘以 100，成功率为匹配分数等于 1 的回合所占的百分比。 任务分数反映对需求的部分满足程度，而成功率衡量任务的完整完成情况。

paragraphs.en: ALFWorld ( Shridhar et al., 2021 ) provides household tasks that require agents to follow natural-language instructions through sequential interactions. The six task categories are Pick , Clean , Cool , Look , Heat , and Pick2 . These tasks involve locating objects and completing prerequisite actions in the appropriate order. Training tasks are drawn from the 3,553 games in the training split, and evaluation tasks are drawn from the 140 games in the held-out seen split. Each episode allows up to 50 environment interactions. An episode is successful when all task goal conditions are satisfied within this limit. We report success rates for each task category and an overall success rate ( All ) computed across all evaluated episodes.

paragraphs.en: We implement ConCal in verl-agent ( Feng et al., 2025 ) with FSDP for policy training and vLLM for rollout generation. We retain the actor-loss reduction used in GiGPO. We fully fine-tune Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct on four NVIDIA H100 GPUs with 80 GB of memory each. We adopt AdamW with a constant learning rate, no warmup, and ( β 1 , β 2 ) = ( 0.9 , 0.999 ) (\beta_{1},\beta_{2})=(0.9,0.999) . Both benchmarks assign a task reward of 10 for successful completion and 0 otherwise, with an additional penalty for invalid actions. Following GiGPO, invalid-action penalties are applied separately from continuation calibration, before step-advantage normalization. We compute step advantages with batch-wise normalization as detailed in Appendix E , while episode-level advantages follow GiGPO. Table 3 summarizes the training and evaluation settings.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 verl-agent（Feng et al., 2025）中实现了 ConCal，使用 FSDP 进行策略训练，并使用 vLLM 进行 rollout 生成。 我们保留了 GiGPO 中使用的 actor 损失归约方式。 我们在四块各具有 80 GB 显存的 NVIDIA H100 GPU 上对 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 进行全量微调。 我们采用 AdamW 优化器，使用恒定学习率，无 warmup，并取 (\beta_{1},\beta_{2})=(0.9,0.999)。 两个基准测试均将成功完成的任务奖励设为 10，否则为 0，并且对无效动作施加额外惩罚。 遵循 GiGPO，无效动作惩罚与延续校准分开施加，并在步级优势归一化之前进行。 我们按附录 E 中详述的批内归一化方式计算步级优势，而回合级优势则遵循 GiGPO。 表 3 总结了训练与评估设置。

paragraphs.en: GraphGPO ( Cheng et al., 2026 ) constructs step rewards from shortest-path distances to successful terminal states. ConCal focuses on calibrating the action-value differences used for local credit. It recursively combines shared continuation evidence with each visit’s own transition target, then evaluates actions using their recorded rewards and actual successors. Its credit therefore reflects estimated discounted returns, while GraphGPO’s credit reflects distance to success on the merged graph. For actions from the same state with equal transition costs and equally distant successors, GraphGPO assigns identical distance-based step rewards. ConCal can still distinguish their action values through differences in recorded rewards and sampled continuation evidence, with partial sharing retaining each visit’s contribution.
paragraphs.zh: GraphGPO（Cheng et al., 2026）根据到成功终止状态的最短路径距离来构建步骤奖励。 ConCal 专注于校准用于局部信用分配的动作价值差异。 它递归地将共享的后续证据与每次访问自身的转移目标相结合，然后使用记录的奖励和实际后继状态来评估动作。 因此，它的信用反映的是估计的折扣回报，而 GraphGPO 的信用反映的是在合并图上到成功的距离。 对于来自同一状态、转移成本相同且后继状态距离相等的动作，GraphGPO 会分配相同的基于距离的步骤奖励。 ConCal 仍可通过记录的奖励和采样的后续证据的差异来区分这些动作的价值，同时部分共享机制保留了每次访问各自的贡献。

paragraphs.en: SALT ( Li et al., 2026 ) averages trajectory-level advantages across matched transitions to assign step-level credit. ConCal instead recursively calibrates continuation values by partially pooling targets r + γ ​ V ^ r+\gamma\widehat{V} across visits matched by their incoming transitions, retaining each visit’s own transition contribution. It constructs action values from recorded rewards and calibrated continuation estimates at their actual successors, then derives local advantages through state-group centering. Recursive propagation also reaches earlier actions whose successor visits have no direct cross-trajectory match. SALT focuses on refining trajectory-level advantages into step-level credit, whereas our study centers on continuation-value estimation before local credit is formed. We provide an in-depth empirical analysis of how calibration changes preference strength and action ordering, and how normalization preserves or suppresses the resulting value gaps in local credit.
paragraphs.zh: SALT（Li et al., 2026）对匹配转移上的轨迹级优势取平均，以分配步骤级信用。 ConCal 则通过部分池化按其入边转移匹配的多次访问之间的目标值 r + γ ​ V ^ r+\gamma\widehat{V}，递归地校准延续价值，同时保留每次访问自身转移的贡献。 它利用记录的奖励和在实际后继处的校准延续估计来构造动作价值，再通过状态组中心化推导局部优势。 递归传播还能到达那些后继访问没有直接跨轨迹匹配的更早动作。 SALT 侧重于将轨迹级优势细化为步骤级信用，而我们的研究聚焦于在局部信用形成之前的延续价值估计。 我们对校准如何改变偏好强度与动作排序、以及归一化如何在局部信用中保留或压制所产生的价值差距进行了深入的实证分析。

paragraphs.en: Concurrent work GRAFT ( Yao et al., 2026 ) explicitly constructs a trajectory graph and estimates shared node values through empirical Bellman iteration. It derives step advantages from node-value differences and further refines them with Graph GAE. ConCal instead partially shares continuation evidence across visits matched by incoming transitions while retaining a separate estimate for each visit (Equation 9 ). Its recursive updates operate directly on recorded visits without explicitly constructing a transition graph. Action values combine recorded rewards with calibrated continuations at actual successors, with the state-group mean providing the local baseline. GRAFT focuses on graph-based state-value recovery and step-advantage construction, whereas our study centers on partial continuation calibration and its effects on relative action values. Using held-out returns, our in-depth empirical analysis distinguishes preference-strength calibration from action-order changes: Gap-matched reproduces most of ConCal’s centered-MSE reduction relative to Own-MC through magnitude adjustment, while ConCal also improves ordering agreement.
paragraphs.zh: 同期工作 GRAFT（Yao et al., 2026）显式构建轨迹图，并通过经验贝尔曼迭代估计共享节点价值。 该方法从节点价值之差推导步骤优势，并进一步用图版 GAE 对其加以精化。 ConCal 则在由入边转移匹配的多次访问之间部分共享延续证据，同时为每次访问保留各自的估计（式 9）。 其递归更新直接在记录的访问上进行，而无需显式构建转移图。 动作价值将记录的奖励与实际后继处经过校准的延续相结合，并以状态组均值作为局部基线。 GRAFT 侧重于基于图的状态价值恢复与步骤优势构建，而我们的研究聚焦于部分延续校准及其对相对动作价值的影响。 基于留出回报，我们的深入实证分析将偏好强度校准与动作顺序变化区分开来：Gap-matched 通过幅度调整复现了 ConCal 相对 Own-MC 的中心化 MSE 降幅的大部分，而 ConCal 还改善了一致性排序。
